failure.message: Either input_pdb or input_pdb_asset must be specified

generation.contig_interpretation: Generate one unconditional protein chain of exactly 70 residues; no source PDB, retained chain, motif, or hotspot is supplied.

manifest.scope_statement: A passing design means only that RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and Boltz-2 were computationally self-consistent at the pre-registered global RMSD threshold. It does not show folding, stability, expression, binding, function, or biological success. pLDDT, pTM, and scRMSD are not biological-property evidence.

success_criterion.bar_basis: Published RFdiffusion work defines in-silico success using a high-confidence prediction and global RMSD below 2 A. Independent benchmarking reports over 95% designability for moderately sized unconditional RFdiffusion backbones; this bounded run pre-registers a conservative 50% pair-level operational floor rather than claiming that benchmark performance transfers to this hosted route.
